text:
Maya: quick pass on the compare table mock in figma — dropping notes here. main things i noticed: badge density feels noisy, pin affordance is ambiguous, and some filter labels read oddly. link: https://figma.redwood/example

Alex: looks good overall, but agree about badges. the perf badges are too saturated — makes rows feel busy. :eyes:

Raj: for pinning, are we doing per-user pin or org-level? current mock looks like it persists across views which could be surprising.

Maya: thinking per-user by default, but a tooltip that says "pins persist in this workspace" could clarify. open to alternatives.

Sora: accessibility nit — the badge color contrast on yellow -> white text fails AA at small sizes. suggest either darker text or an outline. i'll run it through axe.

Jordan: hover timing: badges reveal extra info on hover after 300ms now. feels laggy. can we surface key info on focus (keyboard) and shorten hover delay to 120ms? also ensure reduced-motion respects preferences.

DesignBot: automated accessibility scan results: badge-yellow (#FFD271) with white text -> contrast ratio 2.8:1. recommended text color #3B2F00 or use dark label.

Alex: copy tweak: current tooltip says "Pinned - version 2". change to "Pinned to compare: v2 (you)" — more explicit and helps multi-user clarity.

Maya: love that. also microcopy for filters — "Model signature" is vague. suggest "Architecture / Family" or split into two filters.

Raj: about table density: we have compact vs comfy modes elsewhere. can we show badges only in compact mode and full label in comfy? or allow toggle per-user?

Sora: keyboard flow: when you open compare, focus should land on the first row checkbox, not the search. otherwise keyboard users have extra tabbing. add aria-live for badge status updates.

Jordan: visual idea — replace full solid badges with small outline chips, then expand on hover. reduces visual weight and helps scanning. quick mock incoming.

Alex: performance badge semantics: green = <50ms p50, amber = 50-150ms, red = >150ms (p50). let's call this out in legend copy rather than tooltip. users kept asking what thresholds mean.

Maya: decision proposal: 1) change badge palette to higher contrast and outline chips, 2) update pin microcopy to "Pinned to compare: vX (you/org)" and make pin per-user with an optional org toggle, 3) reduce badge hover delay and ensure keyboard focus reveals same data, 4) move perf thresholds to legend copy and link to docs. anyone object?

Raj: no objections. will prototype pin UX with toggles (per-user vs org) and include a confirmation for org pins.

Sora: i'll run contrast/keyboard tests and post results. expect a11y checklist by EOD.

Alex: i'll update the copy strings and add small localized variants.

Jordan: sending compact mock in 20m — will include outline chips + hover expansion and motion-reduced variant.

Maya: thanks team — action items grouped: Alex (copy), Raj (pin prototype), Jordan (mock), Sora (a11y checks). i'll follow up with a short async review thread once mocks are in. :thumbsup:

DesignBot: reminder: upload design tokens snapshot to /shared/design-tokens when ready.

Maya: noted. leaving this open until prototypes land.
